# v3.23-dev

## Fixed

- **OLX Sub-Items are findable again in Admin > Training Data.** A sub-item attached to a parent OLX was invisible from the list: searching for its name returned nothing, and setting the **Type** filter to **OLX Sub-Item** returned nothing either — because that filter also removes the OLX parents, taking the nested sub-item rows with them. The only way to edit one was to hunt down its parent, detach the sub-item, edit it, and re-attach it.

  Now, as soon as you **search**, or set the **Type** filter to **OLX Sub-Item**, matching sub-items appear as ordinary top-level rows. Click one (or its **Edit** button) to go straight to its detail page — no detaching required.

## Updated

- A sub-item surfaced this way shows a **"↳ Sub-item of: …"** line naming its parent OLX, alongside the existing "→ Leads to:" and "→ Replaced by:" lines, so you can see where it belongs without opening it.
- The default browsing view is unchanged: with no search or Type filter in play, the list still shows one row per Full Title, with sub-items tucked away behind their parent OLX's expand arrow.
